words.meaning: A state of awed admiration, curiosity, or surprise sparked by everyday marvels.
words.sentence1: She looked at the golden morning light filtering through the kitchen window with quiet wonderment. (She looked at the golden morning light filtering through the kitchen window with quiet wonderment.)
words.sentence2: A child can turn an ordinary garden snail into a source of infinite wonderment. (A child can turn an ordinary garden snail into a source of infinite wonderment.)

words.meaning: A feeling of deep wonder, awe, or astonishment at something unexpected.
words.sentence1: Los ninos contemplaban con asombro como caia la primera nieve en la calle. (The children watched with wonder as the first snow fell on the street.)
words.sentence2: El asombro de las pequenas cosas cotidianas llena el corazon de paz. (The wonder of small everyday things fills the heart with peace.)

words.meaning: A sense of astonishment, marvel, or pleasant surprise found in life's occurrences.
words.sentence1: Il regardait les rues humides apres l'orage avec un doux etonnement. (He looked at the damp streets after the storm with a gentle sense of wonder.)
words.sentence2: Retrouver la capacite d'etonnement transforme une journee ordinaire en aventure. (Rediscovering the capacity for wonder transforms an ordinary day into an adventure.)

words.meaning: The act or state of marveling and feeling wonder at the simple reality of life.
words.sentence1: Sie blieb voller Staunen vor dem alten Baum im Stadtpark stehen. (She stopped full of wonder in front of the old tree in the city park.)
words.sentence2: Das tagliche Staunen uber kleine Wunder erhellt die dunklen Tage. (Daily wonder at small miracles brightens dark days.)

words.meaning: A sunny spot or sun-warmed pocket, evoking the cozy, quiet wonder of ordinary afternoons.
words.sentence1: Neko ga engawa no hidamari de kimochiyosa sou ni nemutte iru. (The cat is sleeping comfortably in the sunny spot on the veranda.)
words.sentence2: Fuyu no hidamari ni iru to, nichijou no arigatasa o kanjiru. (Being in a winter sun pocket makes one feel the grateful wonder of everyday life.)

words.meaning: A feeling of awe, enchantment, or breathless wonder before the beauty of the world.
words.sentence1: Il silenzio della citta all'alba suscita sempre un profondo stupore. (The silence of the city at dawn always awakens deep wonder.)
words.sentence2: Guardava con stupore il vapore che saliva dalla tazza di caffe. (She watched with wonder as steam rose from the cup of coffee.)

words.meaning: Wonder, marvel, or pleasant surprise at discovering beauty in the familiar.
words.sentence1: Tade yanjing li shanshuozhe dui zhege shijie de jingqi. (Her eyes sparkled with wonder towards this world.)
words.sentence2: Pingdan de shenghuo li yirang chongman le lingren gandong de jingqi. (Ordinary daily life is still full of touching wonders.)

words.meaning: Wonder, marvel, or miraculous awe found in existence and surrounding nature.
words.sentence1: Maeil tteoneun aetchim haessal-eun saeroun gyeong-i-reul seonmulhanda. (The morning sunlight rising every day gifts a fresh sense of wonder.)
words.sentence2: Sosohan ilsang sog-eseo gyeong-i-reul balgyeonhaneun maeum-i sojung-hada. (The heart that discovers wonder in humble daily life is truly precious.)

words.meaning: Wondrous, marvelous, or astonishing; evoking a sudden sense of admiration.
words.sentence1: Pheap sngop-ngat nei pel preuk ku pit chea aschar nas. (The stillness of the morning is truly wondrous.)
words.sentence2: Kruo-sa neng mitt-pheak thveu aoy chivit thngai nih mian pheap aschar. (Family and friends make life today full of wonder.)

words.meaning: Amazement, awe, or wonder felt when beholding the richness of daily existence.
words.sentence1: Hy het met groot verwondering gekyk hoe die blomme in die oggend oopgaan. (He watched with great wonder as the flowers opened in the morning.)
words.sentence2: Om die lewe met verwondering te benader maak elke oomblik kosbaar. (Approaching life with wonder makes every moment precious.)
